function: DDPG agent jointly decides user-UAV association, uplink bandwidth allocation and UAV CPU allocation to maximize long-term QoE and fairness under UAV energy budgets (p. 5, 6).
system: HAP controller, K=3 hovering UAV servers (H=100 m), I=20 ground MDs, air-to-ground uplink with 10 MHz bandwidth; antennas and carrier frequency not stated; no RIS (p. 3, 9).
method: DDPG actor-critic reinforcement learning (three hidden layers, 256 units) with prioritized replay and weighted importance sampling; Lyapunov virtual queue handles the energy constraint; trained online (p. 6-9).
data_channel: Custom simulator: probabilistic LoS/NLoS path loss with sigmoid LoS probability (g0=-30 dB, exponent 2), small-scale fading unspecified, random MD positions; no dataset (p. 3, 4, 9).
test_conditions: Trained online and evaluated by averaging independent runs; sweeps over harvested energy, CPU capacity, data size, number of MDs and UAVs; no cross-condition test stated (p. 9-11).
baselines: POMDP [45] (partial knowledge of dynamics), IGS [46] (iterative subproblem solving), Uniform (nearest server, equal resources), Random; model-based or heuristic, no learned baseline (p. 10).
metrics: Average QoE, UAV energy consumption (J), task completion rate, Jain fairness index, average reward convergence per episode (p. 9-12).
complexity: Orders for training C1 and execution C2 (layer-width products), overall O(|S| x |A| x Ci); no measured runtime or parameter count (p. 8).
q1_support: p. 3: "the large scale fading channel is expressed using a probabilistic path-loss model"; a custom LoS/NLoS model following [24], [25], with small-scale fading unspecified, and no 3GPP model, public dataset or measured data.
q2_support: p. 10: "Convergence performance with varying numbers of UAVs and MDs"; each K and I is trained (curves against training episode), the actor size depends on I and K (p. 8), and no model trained in one condition is tested in another.
q3_support: p. 10: "We compare the performance of the proposed algorithm with four baseline schemes"; POMDP, IGS, Uniform and Random are model-based or heuristic, and no earlier learned method or plain DDPG baseline is compared.
q4_support: p. 8: "the overall computational complexity can be expressed as" O(|S| x |A| x Ci), with the orders of training and execution cost given in the same subsection; no measured runtime.
q5_support: p. 9: "We simulate a network consisting of K = 3 UAVs hovering at an altitude of H = 100 m"; custom simulation, no code or data link, and no public dataset.
notes: Borderline eligibility: the DDPG action mixes association and CPU allocation (above PHY) with bandwidth allocation on aerial links (p. 6: "how much bandwidth and computing resources should be allocated to each task"), which step 1 treats as physical layer when learned jointly, so included in area 6; the reviewer may prefer exclude above_phy. Table I read from the page image (p. 9). POMDP baseline is model-based.
